name: Heidi
tagline: AI medical scribe that turns the consultation into structured clinical notes.
description: Heidi is an AI scribe for clinicians that listens to a consultation and drafts structured notes, referral letters, and patient handouts in real time, with customizable templates and support for 100+ languages. It pairs the Scribe with Evidence (clinical lookup), Remote (a wearable capture mode), and Comms for follow-up. A free tier covers unlimited basic consults, while paid tiers add EHR push and team features.
insight: Melbourne-based; raised a $65M USD Series B in Oct 2025 at a ~$465M valuation, and opened the round for clinicians to invest.
edge: A genuinely useful free tier plus 100+ languages across 116 countries — unusually open access for a clinical-grade ambient scribe.
pros: Generous free plan for solo clinicians
Web plus iOS and Android apps
cons: Note transfer can be manual on lower tiers

references.title: Heidi Health raises $65M to expand global reach of its AI medical scribe
